# Aether Source Atlas v0.1

## Preface: The Four-Tier Provenance System

The Aether Source Atlas catalogs every resource the platform draws on — from satellite-measured terrain to channeled symbol systems to UFO eyewitness reports. These things are not equal in kind, and pretending they are would corrupt the whole enterprise. So every source carries a provenance tier:

- **A-measured** — Hard scientific data and instrument output: elevation rasters, ephemerides, star catalogs, geomagnetic/seismic/gravity grids, exact mathematical constants. Reproducible, authoritative, API- or download-accessible.
- **B-scholarly** — Peer-reviewed and academic/archaeological work: gazetteers of antiquity, archaeoastronomy scholarship, official government investigative archives, heritage registers, critical-edition primary-source transcriptions.
- **C-traditional** — Established esoteric and symbolic traditions: ley-line theory, planetary grids, astrological systems, gematria ciphers, sigil grammars, sacred-site catalogs, solfeggio frequencies. Coherent, historically rooted, interpretive rather than measured.
- **D-folklore** — Reports, conspiracy lore, and fiction: UFO/haunting sighting databanks, grid-compilation sites, DC-layout conspiracy material, explicitly fictional motifs.

**Why tiering serves accuracy without hiding anything.** Tiering is not censorship — it is the opposite. *Every layer is kept.* A dowsed energy current, a channeled degree symbol, and a fictional transmutation array all belong in the Atlas; they are simply labeled for what they are. The point is that when a pattern *does* hold up — a real solstice alignment, a genuine Masonic cornerstone ceremony, a measured magnetic anomaly — it stands on firm, A/B ground and can be told apart from the C/D material it sits beside. Honest labels let confirmed patterns earn trust while the speculative and the symbolic remain fully visible, browsable, and rich. The tier is metadata, never a delete key.

## 5. Anomalous, Paranormal & UAP/UFO Activity Databases

> **CRITICAL CAVEAT:** Every source here catalogs *reports* — eyewitness accounts, folklore, submitted claims — not verified phenomena. Even official archives (Blue Book, AARO, GEIPAN) catalog reports and adjudications; the large majority of investigated cases resolve to mundane causes. Treat all coordinates/dates/shapes as "what was reported."

## Gaps — Where Aether Must Generate Its Own Data

No external source supplies these. They are the platform's core original work, and most must be tagged Tier C/D and disclosed as derived/authored, never measured.

**Lines & grids (the "energy" geometry itself)**
- **No redistributable, machine-readable global ley/energy-line dataset exists.** Aether must *procedurally synthesize* the Becker-Hagens 15 great circles / 62 nodes from the icosa-dodeca math, and generate the Hartmann/Curry nets from their metric spacings (drawn on-the-fly as a shader/parametric overlay clipped to viewport — billions of lines can't be stored).
- **Named famous leys** (St Michael/Michael-Mary) have real anchor coordinates but no canonical polyline — the route is an authored interpretation hand-built from the site list; the dowsed "current" is unmeasurable.
- **Ley-line drawing/detection + nexus-point scoring** are Aether's own algorithms, run over its merged POI layer, *with a Monte-Carlo random-point null baseline (Broadbent/Behrend)* so the map shows observed-vs-expected rather than chance lines presented as signal.

**The POI archive (merge, dedupe, crosswalk)**
- No single open gazetteer has uniform global coverage *and* open redistribution. Aether must **merge/dedupe OSM + Wikidata + Pleiades + NHLE + NRHP** into one unified point layer and **generate its own entity-resolution + crosswalk-ID layer** (Wikidata is the closest spine but sparse on tradition-based sacred sites).
- **Sacred/energy sites** (Sedona vortexes, New-Age power places) have no authoritative dataset — Aether must curate its own coordinate+attribute records (vortex type, polarity, tradition source) at Tier C.
- **Restricted/sacred coordinates** (NPS/tDAR/tribal) must be coarse-located (park-centroid) and flagged protected — never scraped from restricted tribal data.
- **Copyrighted catalogs** (Megalithic Portal, sacredsites.com) cannot be redistributed — re-derive POIs from open sources and write original descriptions.

**Celestial alignment & correspondence**
- **No open dataset gives ancient-epoch star positions** — Aether must precess + proper-motion-correct Hipparcos/HYG to target epochs (e.g. 7 BC, 2500 BC) itself.
- **No vetted database of site→celestial alignment azimuths/declinations** — Aether must derive target declination vs. horizon azimuth per site, model the **local horizon from DEM/terrain**, account for refraction/obliquity, and apply Ruggles-style significance testing.
- **Constellation line figures have no standard** — curating/reconciling competing sky-culture line-art is Aether's editorial call.
- **The KJV/esoteric correspondence graph** (Pisces=Messiah, the Mazzaroth, decans, fixed stars↔scripture) is unique to Aether — hard astronomy supplies positions; the *meaning mapping* is Tier C/D and must be generated.

**The Lexicon engine**
- No open dataset maps **Strong's numbers/KJV words → multi-system gematria values** — Aether must join Strong's + a gematria engine to generate the lookup table.
- **English gematria has no canonical standard** — pick and hardcode the cipher table, document the choice, tag English values C-traditional.
- **No machine-readable kameas + Rose Cross letter geometry** — encode the 7 magic squares + petal positions as data to auto-generate name-sigils; the **chaos-magic glyph-fusion step is generative** (Aether's own path-composition).
- **No shape→meaning symbol-recognition dataset** — build a shape-feature taxonomy + lookup from Liungman's blueprint.
- **"Reading holy language in the land"** (geolocating gematria/symbolic resonance to places) joins STEPBible TIPNR + a gematria engine + geospatial layer — a cross-walk that exists nowhere and must be generated.

**Resonance correspondences**
- **No measured substrate for any unified "earth energy" / "subtle energy" field.** Aether must synthesize any composite index from real layers (magnetic/gravity anomaly, fault proximity, geoelectric, radon) and **disclose it as a derived construct, never a measured quantity.**
- **Schumann resonance is a single global cavity, not a geographic field** — any "Schumann at your location" is fabricated; render it as a global panel only, and the live feed is an image embed (no clean API).
